name: 伯努利方程（求下游流速）计算器

map.由上下游压强、流速、高程，按能量守恒求下游流速 v₂。: From upstream/downstream pressure, velocity, and elevation, find downstream velocity v\u2082 by energy conservation.
map.伯努利：P + ½ρv² + ρgz = 常数（忽略损失，理想不可压定常流）。: Bernoulli: P + \u00bd\u03c1v\u00b2 + \u03c1gz = constant (loss neglected, ideal incompressible steady flow).
map.📚 深度解析：伯努利方程求流速与压降: 📚 In-depth: Bernoulli for velocity and pressure drop
map.已知两点压差求管道流速或反之。: Given pressure difference between two points, find pipe velocity or vice versa.
map.文丘里、喷嘴等节流装置的流速推算。: Velocity estimation for throttling devices like Venturi and nozzles.
map.高位水箱重力流校核出口速度。: Check outlet velocity of gravity flow from an elevated tank.
map.p1−p2=10 kPa、ρ=1000、忽略高差与损失，v2=√(2×10000: p1\u2212p2=10 kPa, \u03c1=1000, neglect elevation and loss: v2=\u221a(2\u00d710000/1000 + v1\u00b2)\u22484.47 m/s (v1 very small).
map.落差 5 m 全转速度，v=√(2×9.81×5)≈9.9 m/s，体现位能转动: 5 m drop fully to velocity: v=\u221a(2\u00d79.81\u00d75)\u22489.9 m/s, showing potential-to-kinetic conversion.
map.理想、定常、不可压、沿流线；实际需另加沿程与局部损失项修正。: Ideal, steady, incompressible, along a streamline; in practice add friction and minor-loss terms.
map.在等式两边加 h_f（沿程）+ h_L（局部），用达西或局部损失公式求。: Add h_f (friction) + h_L (minor) to both sides; compute with Darcy or minor-loss formulas.
